method: Area-weighted centroid and normals of projecting barrel rim within first 2 percent of gun depth; offset 0.6 percent of gun depth beyond forward surface. Neutral imported Idle pose sampled on isolated preview-scene clone, then local point/rotation transferred. Existing markers retained.
realMeshValidation: Algorithm evaluated on actual exported FBX pistol geometry. Render visually verified marker centred in barrel opening and ray pointing out. Wider 5 percent front-cap slab was rejected because it included lower receiver. Reflection/rotation/uniform-scale/translation invariance checked.
limits: Unity Editor unavailable. Geometry and C# syntax/API review do not replace Editor-side execution or device testing. Geometric extraction is specific to these pistols sampled in forward-facing Idle pose; new weapon models need suitable markers.
